title: One Piece
author: Eiichiro Oda
description: Gold Roger was known as the 'Pirate King', the strongest and most infamous being to have sailed the Grand Line.

title: Naruto
author: Masashi Kishimoto
description: Naruto Uzumaki is a young ninja who seeks gain recognition from his peers and also dreams of becoming the Hokage.

title: Bleach
author: Tite Kubo
description: Ichigo Kurosaki never asked for the ability to see ghosts — he was born with the gift.

title: Dragon Ball
author: Akira Toriyama
description: Bulma is a girl in search of the mystical Dragonballs that when brought together grant any wish.

title: Attack on Titan
author: Hajime Isayama
description: Centuries ago, mankind was slaughtered to near extinction by monstrous humanoid creatures called titans.

title: Death Note
author: Tsugumi Ohba
description: A shinigami, as a god of death, can kill any person—provided they see their victim's face and write their victim's name in a notebook called a Death Note.

title: Fullmetal Alchemist
author: Hiromu Arakawa
description: In an alchemical ritual gone wrong, Edward Elric loses his arm and his leg, and his brother Alphonse became nothing but a soul in a suit of armor.

title: Hunter x Hunter
author: Yoshihiro Togashi
description: Gon Freecss is a young boy who lives on Whale Island. He learns from 'Hunter' Kite that his father, whom he thought was dead, is actually alive and well.

title: One Punch Man
author: ONE
description: The seemingly ordinary and unimpressive Saitama has a rather unique hobby: being a hero.

title: My Hero Academia
author: Kohei Horikoshi
description: In a world where people with superpowers (known as 'Quirks') are the norm, Izuku Midoriya has dreams of one day becoming a Hero.

title: Demon Slayer
author: Koyoharu Gotouge
description: Tanjiro Kamado's life is ruined when a demon kills his entire family and turns his sister into a demon.

title: Jujutsu Kaisen
author: Gege Akutami
description: Yuji Itadori, a high school student, swallows a cursed finger to save his friends and becomes the host of Sukuna.

title: Chainsaw Man
author: Tatsuki Fujimoto
description: Denji, a poor young man, becomes the Chainsaw Man after merging with his pet devil dog, Pochita.

title: Spy x Family
author: Tatsuya Endo
description: A spy, an assassin, and a telepath must act like a family for their own individual reasons.

title: Blue Lock
author: Muneyuki Kaneshiro
description: Japan seeks to create the ultimate striker by putting 300 young forwards in a prison-like facility called Blue Lock.

title: Tokyo Revengers
author: Ken Wakui
description: Takemichi Hanagaki travels back in time to save his middle school girlfriend from being killed by a gang.

title: Berserk
author: Kentaro Miura
description: Guts, a lone mercenary, and Griffith, the leader of the Band of the Hawk, navigate a brutal world of demons and fate.

title: Vagabond
author: Takehiko Inoue
description: A fictionalized account of the life of the legendary Japanese swordsman Miyamoto Musashi.

title: Slam Dunk
author: Takehiko Inoue
description: Hanamichi Sakuragi, a delinquent, joins the basketball team to impress a girl and discovers his passion for the sport.

title: Haikyuu!!
author: Haruichi Furudate
description: Shoyo Hinata, a short high schooler, aims to become a great volleyball player like his idol, the 'Little Giant'.

title: Kingdom
author: Yasuhisa Hara
description: In ancient China, two orphans dream of becoming the 'Greatest Generals Under the Heavens'.

title: Vinland Saga
author: Makoto Yukimura
description: Thorfinn, a young Viking warrior, seeks revenge against the man who killed his father.

title: Monster
author: Naoki Urasawa
description: Dr. Kenzo Tenma, a neurosurgeon, hunts down a former patient who has become a serial killer.

title: 20th Century Boys
author: Naoki Urasawa
description: A group of friends must stop a mysterious cult leader known as 'Friend' who is using their childhood stories to destroy the world.

title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
author: Hirohiko Araki
description: The multi-generational story of the Joestar family and their battles against supernatural foes.

title: Fairy Tail
author: Hiro Mashima
description: Lucy Heartfilia joins the chaotic Fairy Tail guild and embarks on magical adventures with Natsu Dragneel.

title: Seven Deadly Sins
author: Nakaba Suzuki
description: Princess Elizabeth searches for the Seven Deadly Sins to help her take back her kingdom from the Holy Knights.

title: Black Clover
author: Yuki Tabata
description: Asta, a boy born without magic in a world where magic is everything, aims to become the Wizard King.

title: The Promised Neverland
author: Kaiu Shirai
description: Orphans discover a terrifying secret about their orphanage and plan a daring escape.

title: Dr. Stone
author: Riichiro Inagaki
description: After humanity is turned to stone for thousands of years, a genius boy named Senku aims to rebuild civilization using science.

title: Fire Force
author: Atsushi Ohkubo
description: Special Fire Force units battle spontaneous human combustion and the mystery behind the Adolla Burst.

title: Tokyo Ghoul
author: Sui Ishida
description: Ken Kaneki becomes a half-ghoul after a surviving a run-in with one, and must navigate the world of ghouls and humans.

title: Gintama
author: Hideaki Sorachi
description: In an alternate Edo period occupied by aliens, samurai Gintoki Sakata takes on odd jobs to make a living.

title: Yu Yu Hakusho
author: Yoshihiro Togashi
description: Delinquent Yusuke Urameshi dies saving a child and is brought back to life as a Spirit Detective.

title: Rurouni Kenshin
author: Nobuhiro Watsuki
description: A former assassin, Kenshin Himura, wanders Japan as a rurouni, helping people to atone for his past.

title: Inuyasha
author: Rumiko Takahashi
description: Kagome Higurashi is transported to feudal Japan where she joins the half-demon Inuyasha to recover the Shikon Jewel shards.

title: Mob Psycho 100
author: ONE
description: Shigeo 'Mob' Kageyama, a powerful esper, tries to live a normal life while keeping his emotions under control.

title: Cowboy Bebop
author: Hajime Yatate
description: Bounty hunters Spike Spiegel and Jet Black travel the galaxy on their ship, the Bebop.

title: Sailor Moon
author: Naoko Takeuchi
description: Usagi Tsukino discovers she is Sailor Moon and leads a group of Sailor Guardians to protect the Earth.

title: Cardcaptor Sakura
author: CLAMP
description: Sakura Kinomoto accidentally releases magical Clow Cards and must recapture them to prevent disaster.

title: Fruit Basket
author: Natsuki Takaya
description: Tohru Honda lives with the Sohma family and discovers they are cursed to turn into animals of the Chinese Zodiac.

title: Nana
author: Ai Yazawa
description: Two girls both named Nana meet on a train to Tokyo and become close friends while pursuing their dreams.

title: Your Lie in April
author: Naoshi Arakawa
description: A piano prodigy who lost his ability to play after his mother's death is inspired by a free-spirited violinist.

title: A Silent Voice
author: Yoshitoki Oima
description: A former bully seeks redemption by befriending the deaf girl he once tormented.

title: Horimiya
author: HERO
description: Two high school students with hidden sides discover each other's secrets and fall in love.

title: Kaguya-sama: Love is War
author: Aka Akasaka
description: Two brilliant student council members engage in a battle of wits to make the other confess their love first.

title: Great Teacher Onizuka
author: Toru Fujisawa
description: A former gang member becomes a teacher to fulfill his own unique brand of justice and guidance.

title: Akira
author: Katsuhiro Otomo
description: In post-apocalyptic Neo-Tokyo, a biker gang member gains immense psychic powers.

title: Ghost in the Shell
author: Masamune Shirow
description: Major Motoko Kusanagi and her team investigate cybercrimes in a futuristic world.

title: Parasyte
author: Hitoshi Iwaaki
description: Alien parasites arrive on Earth, taking over human brains, but one fails and ends up in Shinichi Izumi's hand.

title: Uzumaki
author: Junji Ito
description: A town becomes obsessed and haunted by spiral patterns that slowly consume everything.

title: Gantz
author: Hiroya Oku
description: People who die are resurrected by a black sphere and forced to fight alien monsters in a deadly game.

title: Deadman Wonderland
author: Jinsei Kataoka
description: Ganta Igarashi is wrongly accused of murdering his classmates and sent to a brutal prison amusement park.

title: Elfen Lied
author: Lynn Okamoto
description: A mutant girl with deadly invisible arms escapes a research facility, leaving a trail of blood.

title: Claymore
author: Norihiro Yagi
description: Female warriors infused with demon blood hunt down monsters known as Yoma in a medieval world.

title: Blue Exorcist
author: Kazue Kato
description: Rin Okumura discovers he is the son of Satan and decides to become an exorcist to defeat his father.

title: D.Gray-man
author: Katsura Hoshino
description: Allen Walker and other Exorcists fight against the Millennium Earl and his army of Akuma.

title: Soul Eater
author: Atsushi Ohkubo
description: Students at a special academy hunt down evil souls to turn their partners into powerful Death Scythes.

title: Noragami
author: Adachitoka
description: A minor god named Yato seeks to become a famous deity with his own shrine.

title: Magi: The Labyrinth of Magic
author: Shinobu Ohtaka
description: Aladdin and Alibaba explore magical dungeons and discover their destiny in a world of djinns.
